snippet.title: Mimic Party — Announcement Trailer | One take. Your voice. Good luck.
snippet.description:
Imitate a sound with your voice. One take. No second chance.

🎯 WISHLIST ON STEAM → https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053820/Mimic_Party/

Mimic Party is a vocal party game for 2 to 5 players. Every round, the whole table
hears the same reference sound a cow, a chainsaw, a dial-up modem and everyone
gets one shot to recreate it with nothing but their voice. An AI scores how close
you got. Your friends decide how much they laughed.

Then there's sabotage. Spend your tokens to wreck someone's take before the table
hears it: pitch it, drown it in echo, chop it to pieces or swap it out entirely
for something horrendous.

🎤 IN THE GAME
• 2–5 players online, voice chat built in
• One-shot recording — no retries, no editing, no hiding
• AI scoring on pitch, rhythm and delivery — not on your microphone or your voice type
• Sabotage tokens to ruin someone's big moment
• Steam Workshop: build your own sound packs and share them with everyone
• English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
• PC & Mac

No release date : Q3 2026. Wishlisting is what tells us to hurry. 👇

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053820/Mimic_Party/
